verdict.rationale: Viam documents standardized component APIs: every camera exposes the same GetImage() regardless of brand, and the same holds for motors, sensors and arms. It explicitly states you can swap hardware without rewriting code, and that changing a camera or motor in config keeps code working. Hardware models are selected in config with Registry drivers, and custom driver modules behave like built-in components with the SDKs working automatically. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that hardware swaps work without code changes in practice.
